title: P44: keyMaterial request signed with suite 1
description: protocol-06 §5.2 KeyMaterialRequest has acceptableCiphersuites<V> but no single cipher_suite, so the signature scheme for key_material_request_signature is unstated. Readings: (a) first listed suite; (b) require suite 1 in the list and sign/verify with its Ed25519 (mimid-1wgh.23). Chosen: (b); list order has no stated meaning. wg item filed.
